build_pose_from_Rt: build a camera pose tensor from rotation matrix R and translation vector t using the Pose class
compose_camera_poses: compose a sequence of camera poses together using Pose.compose to chain transformations
convert_so3_to_SO3: convert an SO(3) Lie algebra vector to a rotation matrix using Lie.so3_to_SO3
convert_quaternion_to_rotation: convert a quaternion to a 3x3 rotation matrix using Quaternion.q_to_R
compute_novel_view_poses: generate N novel circular viewpoint poses around an anchor pose using get_novel_view_poses
